meta.title: Top 10 Best Places to Visit in Vietnam - Travel Video 2026
meta.description:
Looking for the best places to visit in Vietnam? This beautiful Southeast Asian country is filled with breathtaking coastlines, lush mountains, ancient temples, vibrant cities, and charming traditional villages. From the dramatic limestone islands of Ha Long Bay to the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, Vietnam offers an incredible mix of natural beauty, rich history, culture, and unforgettable experiences.

In this video, we explore the best places to visit in Vietnam — including the spectacular limestone landscapes of Ha Long Bay, the historic streets of Hanoi, and the vibrant energy of Ho Chi Minh City. Discover the charming lantern-filled town of Hoi An, explore the beautiful beaches of Da Nang, visit the ancient imperial city of Hue, and experience the stunning rice terraces of Sapa. Explore the scenic landscapes of Ninh Binh, discover the tropical beauty of Phu Quoc Island, and enjoy the incredible scenery of the Mekong Delta. Each destination offers its own blend of culture, history, local cuisine, and breathtaking landscapes.

Whether you're planning a Vietnam adventure, exploring Southeast Asia, or simply looking for travel inspiration, these incredible destinations showcase the diverse landscapes, fascinating heritage, and unforgettable experiences that make Vietnam a must-visit destination.
